in_sanskrit.name: शरिन्द्र
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: शरि (Shari) - Shining, radiant, द्र (Dra) - Lord. So, Sharindra is the 'Lord of the Shining' or 'Radiant One'.

in_hindi.name: शरिन्द्र
in_hindi.long_meaning: शरीर (Sharir) - Body, इंद्र (Indra) - Lord. So, Sharindra is the 'Lord of the Body' or 'Lord of the Person'. In Hindu mythology, Indra is the god of rain and thunder, and he is also considered the god of the body, as he is responsible for the life-giving rain that sustains all life.
